# Dotenv Exposure Checker

> Paste your site's URL to see whether its .env file is publicly reachable. Reports which variable names are declared, never their values. Free, runs from your browser or a CLI, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
